peer.coverage: Cross-model independent adversarial review: not run — no different-provider CLI installed on this machine (only the claude CLI, same serving family as the host); the adversarial lens ran in-process instead.

coverage_notes: Standards criteria came from the instruction-file fallback: repo root CLAUDE.md (no CODING_STANDARDS.md or AGENTS.md exists in this repo).
Untracked files excluded from scope: five docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-30-* plan drafts and spec/PCS-SPEC-P10*.md (untracked spec draft).

Base correction: the invocation named base:58341eb, but that commit IS the #1 snapshot fix; using it as base would have excluded the committee-mandated #1 scope from the diff. Scope was re-based to 2bc2398 (the commit before the fix batch) = the whole fix batch.

Dispatch degradation: three reviewers were cut off by the account's API quota (429). security and adversarial were re-dispatched and completed; the data-migration reviewer's findings were reconstructed from the testing reviewer's two delegated deep-dive sub-reports plus orchestrator direct database verification (see the data-migration entry in raw-returns.json). Its reasoning is attributed evidence, not an independent persona return.
The performance persona was deliberately NOT selected for this round: the fix batch has no measurable performance surface. Coverage should not claim a performance lens ran.

★ Evidence correction made during this review (orchestrator-verified, not a reviewer finding): the previous round's QA report claimed 'three targets at p9_014 (head) with alembic check exit 0' for pcs / pcs_test / isolated schema. Direct database inspection showed pcs_test was still at p9_013 with the new column absent — the original run changed os.environ['DATABASE_URL'] inside ONE process, and alembic's pydantic settings instance is cached, so the second 'database' was still pcs (upgrade is idempotent, so both runs printed p9_014 and the output could not distinguish them). pcs_test has since been upgraded in a separate process and verified by direct query (both now p9_014, column present); the QA report was corrected and the failure mode recorded in .wolf/cerebrum.md.
One reviewer artifact (adversarial.json) contained unescaped quotes and was invalid JSON; it was repaired in place (quote-escaping only, no content change) before merging.

testing's delegated sub-reports (mutation-resistance audit of 9 frontend test files; deep verification of the PG engine-level migration tests) are the strongest independent evidence in this round and are preserved verbatim in the reviewer's artifact residual_risks/testing_gaps.
